summary: Phase 3a partial: created NegationClosure.lean with master simultaneous induction architecture (P1(k) + P2(k) by induction on k). The architecture compiles with 3 localized sorries: (1) depth-0 atom/order case analysis (~30 lines), (2) depth-0 backward direction (~80 lines), (3) depth k+1 backward direction (Rabinovich composition/negation closure, ~400-600 lines). The forward direction at all depths is sorry-free. The key architectural contribution: nf_char_kp1_from_2var builds P1(k+1) from P1(k) + P2(k) without calling the sorry'd nf_2var_exist_formula_prior, breaking the circularity that blocked all 5 previous approaches.
blockers: backward_depth0: depth-0 backward direction of nf_exist_formula. Pure case analysis (~80 lines). Unfold nf_exist_formula, case-split on order direction, extract witness from Until/Since, apply nf_2var_depth0_components. Blocked only by Fin case analysis details, not mathematical content.

k+1 backward in master_induction: the Rabinovich composition theorem / negation closure content. On Prior structures, the depth-(k+1) arity-2 NF of (x,t) is determined by the depth-(k+1) arity-1 NFs of x and t plus the order. For points y between t and x, existence is constrained by Prior-UZ/SZ: whether char_k(nf_y) occurs in (t,x) depends on the first/last occurrence position relative to x. Estimated 400-600 lines.
